images.scene: Robinson and his three companions dig and sow a freshly cleared patch of ground with clumsy wooden tools, one man scattering barley seed by hand, a dense tropical wood rising behind the tilled field.
images.alt: Four men dig and sow seed in a cleared field beside tropical woods.

images.scene: A large oak tree felled on the ground is being hewn into long thick planks; a man swings an axe along its trunk while finished broad planks lie stacked beside heaps of wood chips.
images.alt: A man hews a felled oak tree into long planks, with cut boards stacked nearby.

images.scene: The Spaniard and Friday's old father paddle a dugout canoe away from the island under a full moon, each holding a musket, while Robinson watches from the dark shore.
images.alt: Two men paddle a canoe away from the island by moonlight as a figure watches from the beach.

images.scene: Robinson stands at the top of a grassy hill holding a long brass perspective glass to his eye, gazing out to sea where a distant English ship lies at anchor beyond the surf.
images.alt: A man on a hilltop looks through a spyglass at a distant ship anchored at sea.

images.scene: On the beach an insolent seaman raises a great cutlass over a kneeling prisoner who lifts his hands in pleading despair, while two other bound captives sit nearby and the grounded boat rests on the sand.
images.alt: A sailor raises a cutlass over a kneeling prisoner on a beach beside a grounded boat.

images.scene: The rescued ship's captain clubs a wounded mutineer to the ground with the stock of his musket on the beach as gun-smoke drifts, a dead man sprawled nearby and armed companions closing in.
images.alt: A man strikes down a mutineer with a musket stock on a smoky beach after gunfire.
